evidence.contract: Offline generation of a standards-compliant RFC 5545 ICS calendar from operator-supplied JSON on stdin. `semester.start_date` is the week-1 Monday; an occurrence lands on `start_date + (week - 1) * 7 + day_offset` (Monday=0 .. evidence.proof: Final offline suite: 126 passed across five suites (two ignored). Loopback tests cover failed pre-send journaling without a request, malformed 2xx and receipt-persistence failure, account-wide blocking, exact offline resolution/idempotency, tombstone precedence, and a delayed cross-process stale-miss race that sends once. CLI tests and actual binary smoke reject online recovery and malformed typed input before cache/network work.
evidence.safety: The unknown barrier is persisted after the shared governor lease is acquired and before send; it remains through response classification and receipt persistence. Recovery is local-only, never queries/retries the portal, and never claims disconnection.
evidence.limits: No real gateway request, authentication, logout or recovery operation authorized/performed; remote postconditions and endpoint compatibility remain unverified.
evidence.review: Independent exact-head PR approval and maintainer merge approval remain required; neither is claimed.

capabilities.title: Authorized local Life-compatible recording segment lookup
capabilities.acceptance: Read-only operator-authorized SQLite FTS phrase lookup with catalog/query-bound cursors, nullable timing, separate derived/original object descriptors and declared linking hashes; missing/cyclic/limited ancestry explicit; synthetic offline CLI/API proof.
capabilities.scope_boundary: Local catalog/query integration only. No remote object-store retrieval, actual media verification, authentication, transcription/repair or live campus recording access. Parent aggregate capabilities remain pending.

evidence.tests: Before the signed-rowid follow-up, 71 offline tests passed with one ignored subprocess worker and strict clippy; those tests did not cover non-positive IDs. A signed-rowid regression was added but not run under the manual-only follow-up.
evidence.smoke: Prior local-catalog smoke: two valid pages, null timing, distinct original/derived hashes, cursor mismatch rejection, missing-authorization denial and unchanged catalog bytes. The 2026-09-24 follow-up was manually exercised as recorded below.

followup_manual_smoke.manual_output_shape: After the signed-range schema fix, the CLI returned id=-1 with start_ms/end_ms null; `buaa schema` reported id bounds i64::MIN..i64::MAX and nullable non-negative integer timing properties.
followup_manual_smoke.automated_tests: not run; the in-source regression remains unexecuted

evidence.review: Independent review of pre-correction PR head 629a15a1775822915a4ff11ab91769e65a7cb097 found omitted start_ms/end_ms schema properties. They were restored with manual CLI/schema proof; exact-head review of the updated PR #45 is pending.
evidence.privacy: No actual private catalog/media/credentials or private implementation copied; only reviewed non-sensitive structural field/key/relation/FTS facts used.
evidence.limits: Local catalog only, no remote object retrieval or blob verification. Operator attestation is not rights proof. WAL sidecar coordination is possible; no frozen snapshot across requests; metadata and SQL resource bounds are explicit.
